# PayRam

> Private, self-hosted crypto payment gateway: payment links, hosted checkout
> (USDC/BTC/ETH and more), on-chain deposit detection, sweeps to a cold wallet
> you control. No signup, no KYB. This host also serves the PayRam MCP server.

Agents: start at /SKILL.md - it routes you to the right entry point
(setup script for installing, MCP at /mcp for operating/integrating).

## Start here

- [Agent front door (SKILL.md)](https://mcp.payram.com/SKILL.md): what PayRam is, install one-liner, MCP endpoint, credentials
- [MCP endpoint](https://mcp.payram.com/mcp): HTTP JSON-RPC, no auth headers; tools for payment links, diagnosis, codegen
- [Skills index](https://mcp.payram.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): 16 specialized skills (setup, payments, webhooks, payouts, referrals, ...)

## Setup

- [Headless agent setup guide](https://github.com/PayRam/payram-scripts/blob/main/docs/PAYRAM_HEADLESS_AGENT.md): the canonical flow, env vars, merchant/operator modes, troubleshooting
- [Setup script](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PayRam/payram-scripts/main/setup_payram_agents.sh): one-step install -> payment link -> API key
